## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

### Bennison's Bakery in Evanston, IL continues to use "FlakeMor" Shortening since 1952 (5
### Generations)!

What is the secret to your success?

The secret to our success is consistent quality and superior performance. **FlakeMor Shortening**
has been a key ingredient in creating flaky, buttery pastries that our customers love, delivering
outstanding results every time.

Why has Bennison’s Bakery continued to use "FlakeMor" Shortening for over 5 generations?

Bennison’s Bakery continues to use **FlakeMor Shortening** for over five generations because of its
exceptional quality, reliability, and the superior **buttery flavor** it adds to their pastries.
It’s the trusted choice for consistently great results.

What bakery goods use "FlakeMor" Shortening?

**FlakeMor Shortening** is perfect for a wide range of baked goods, including **empanadas**,
**pastelitos**, **Jamaican patties**, **beef patties**, **croissants**, **Danishes**, and **puff
pastries**. It provides a light, flaky texture and rich, buttery flavor in every bite, ensuring your
pastries are always a hit with customers.

How does FlakeMor compare to its competitors?

Unlike most competitors who use **palm oil shortening**—which is harmful to health, the environment,
and wildlife—**FlakeMor** uses **premium soybean oil**, offering a healthier, more sustainable
option. **Palm oil production** contributes to deforestation, threatening animal habitats and
indigenous communities in Malaysia and Indonesia. **FlakeMor** is a better choice for your health,
the environment, and ethical practices.

# Welcome to Allfresh Food Products

world’s finest **soybean shortenings** specifically designed for **puff pastry** and **roll-in
dough** applications.

quality domestic soybean oils. Our process ensures that every batch of **soybean shortening** is
perfectly tempered for days before packaging, resulting in superior **workability** and consistent
performance for professional bakers.

methods, our **soybean shortenings** work flawlessly to create the ideal texture and appearance. The
**buttery flavor** adds a rich, mouthwatering taste, keeping your customers coming back for more.

We pride ourselves on offering **premium soybean shortenings**, trusted by award-winning bakers and
distributors nationwide. With **Allfresh**, you can always count on consistent quality, superior
workability, and exceptional results in every batch of **[puff][61] pastries**, **rolls**, and other
baked goods.

# Exportation des huiles essentielles et végétales de Madagascar

[Aromeya][29] est une société œuvrant dans les **huiles essentielles et végétales de Madagascar**.
Nos produits sont 100% naturels et purs. 

[Voir nos produits][30]
100% Biologique Végétal Naturel Locale Sans substance chimique Sans pesticide

## Huiles essentielles de Madagascar

Découvrez la richesse exceptionnelle **des huiles essentielles de Madagascar**, reconnues pour leurs
vertus magiques. Les bienfaits de ces huiles, spécifiques à Madagascar, sont nombreux. Depuis des
années, elles sont utilisées pour soulager les petits maux du quotidien par ingestion, application
cutanée ou diffusion. Grâce à des recherches approfondies, **nos huiles essentielles de Madagascar**
sont de plus en plus raffinées, préservant leur pureté et leurs propriétés naturelles, sans l’ajout
de produits chimiques.

Aromeya, votre **exportateur d’huiles essentielles de Madagascar**, s’engage à mettre à votre
disposition ces trésors en gros et en détails.

[Découvrez plus d’huiles essentielles de Madagascar][31]

## Huile Végétale de Madagascar 

Les **huiles végétales de Madagascar**, tout comme les **huiles essentielles**, offrent une
multitude de bienfaits. Réputées pour leurs utilisations fréquentes dans les produits de beauté et
les cosmétiques dédiés à la peau et aux cheveux, ces huiles proviennent de la pression à froid ou à
chaud de fruits oléagineux tels que des noix, des graines ou des fruits riches en lipides. Extraite
avec précaution au sein des plantations malgaches, chaque huile végétale est ensuite traitée avec
soin, embouteillée, puis mise à disposition sur les marchés nationaux et internationaux.

Aromeya se consacre avec diligence à la **commercialisation et à l’exportation d’huiles végétales de
Madagascar**, assurant ainsi une qualité exceptionnelle. Explorez notre sélection pour une
expérience de beauté authentique.

[Découvrez plus d’Huiles Végétales de Madagascar][39]

multitude de bienfaits. Réputées pour leurs utilisations fréquentes dans les produits de beauté et

chaud de fruits oléagineux tels que des noix, des graines ou des fruits riches en lipides. Extraite
avec précaution au sein des plantations malgaches, chaque huile végétale est ensuite traitée avec
soin, embouteillée, puis mise à disposition sur les marchés nationaux et internationaux.

Aromeya se consacre avec diligence à la **commercialisation et à l’exportation d’huiles végétales de

# Bakery Ingredients
# Since 1904

Manufacturing, distributing and technically supporting high quality bakery ingredients to the global
bakery market since 1904.

[ Discover global solutions ][65]

# Industrial Solutions

As an industrial manufacturer, are you faced with challenges in keeping customers satisfied,
achieving consistent quality and at the same time, meeting evolving consumer expectations?

[ Discover how we can help ][66]

# Food manufacturing for tomorrow

At Bakels, we are committed to sustainable practises and believe we must play our role to steward
and protect our planet, community and people for this and future generations.

[ Making a difference ][67]

# Insights to help
# grow your business

Our mission is to provide you with the latest market trends, inspiration and business advice, so you
can develop and grow your business to meet the expectations of today's consumer.

[ Learn more ][68]

A network of Baking Centres across the world help our customers create the best baked goods for
local markets.

## Vision

To operate as a dynamic and successful organisation, while providing best-in-class services to
become customers’ first choice for bakery ingredients.

## Mission

To be a technically based company, whose objective is to assist our customers develop, produce and
sell (more) bakery products.

## Values

To live up to our core values being;

###### Integrity

###### Dedication

###### Respect

[Our mission][111]

### Centres of Competence

For over 100 years, Bakels have supplied quality bakery ingredients to professional bakers across
the world. Continued investment has allowed us to build Centres of Competence, which provide
specialist knowledge and expertise to the Group worldwide.

# Bremer Authentic Ingredients

That’s Easy. That’s Authentic. That’s Bremer.

## Who We Are

Bremer Authentic Ingredients is Michigan’s trusted source for your business’s wholesale food
ingredient needs. No matter the [industry][39] or quantity, we’ve been committed to supplying
locally sourced, high-quality ingredients since our founding 65 years ago. 


Here at Bremer, we prioritize ease, authenticity, and satisfaction with every order placed. Bremer
is a local, woman-owned ingredient supplier committed to putting your needs first.

flavor, freshness, and nutritional value, while supporting sustainable organic farming practices.
Wanting a specific organic ingredient? Reach out to us to [request an ingredient][48].

## What we can do for you

## What we can do for you

As the largest unattended retail provider in the U.S., we leverage design expertise, consumer
insights, and the latest in product and equipment innovation to help you create a better workplace
and connect your employees.  Whether your team is looking for great coffee to kick-start their
morning, grab a quick meal, or indulge in their favorite snack, Canteen covers it all with
convenience and great service.

[ Contact Us ][27]
[

## Portfolio of Options

We offer service across multiple lines of business, including micro-markets, traditional vending,
specialty coffee, pantry services, and culinary.

][28]
[

## Market Leader

We have led our industry for 95+ years and are the only truly national service provider with over
225 distribution locations across 48 states.

][29]

Our goal is to provide the food you want when you want it through your preferred method of payment
and delivery—a concept we call food without friction.

## Premium Ingredients

### Excellence delivered, Just in Time

With supply agreements spanning the finest and largest ingredient manufacturers worldwide, we bring
exceptional value to our suppliers and deliver superior products to our customers. Whether locally
sourced or globally procured, we ensure the ingredients you need are always within reach and
delivered just in time.

[Explore Ingredients][41]

## Capabilities

### Solutions Designed for Your Ingredient Needs

From sourcing to shelf, we streamline your ingredient needs with reliable supply, expert
formulation, and precision blending. Our tailored solutions ensure consistency, quality, and
efficiency, so you get the right ingredients, in the right form, delivered seamlessly.

[

Flexible private label solutions that bring your brand to life with care, consistency, and quality.

Learn More

Learn More

### Packaging

Learn More

### A Legacy of Excellence In Food Manufacturing

With 140+ years of combined experience, we deliver superior ingredients and exceptional service. Our
dedicated team understands your product needs and will deliver them to you on-time, every time,
making us your trusted partner in food manufacturing.

# Beef Tallow French Fries Contest

The contest starts on Monday, July 13, and runs through Friday, July 31. Home cooks and restaurant
fans alike have a chance to win—all it takes is one great photo of crispy, golden fries cooked in
Beef Tallow.

[ENTER NOW][33]
[Rediscover beef tallow]

## Back to Tallow

Chefs and operators are rediscovering the flavor, performance, and authenticity of beef
tallow—nature’s original cooking fat.

[LEARN MORE][34]
[Hp hero banner 1]

## Authentic Flavor, Sustainable Lifestyle.

Heritage fats bring traditional, authentic flavor that’s unparalleled in recipes and is a natural
alternative to highly processed vegetable oils.

[View More][35]
[Grilling with Tallow TITLE SLIDE]

## Grilling with Beef Tallow

Whether you’re grilling ribeye, vegetables, or experimenting with creative techniques, tallow can
bring out richer flavors, better textures, and more consistent results. As more chefs and foodies
embrace traditional fats, now’s the perfect time to experiment at your next cookout.

[LEARN MORE][36]
[Hp hero banner 2]

## Better Value for Increased Profits

Lard, beef tallow, and trans fat-free vegetable shortenings save you money — they’re shelf-stable,
need no refrigeration, and don’t oxidize like their hydrogenated vegetable counterparts.

[Infographic][37]
[Hero Banner]

## Embracing Today’s Food Culture

Consumers are recognizing the health benefits of minimally-processed animal fats and shortenings
both at restaurants and in their homes.

[View More][38]
[Intro 1601671854]

## Join Our Mailing List

Sign up for our mailing list** **to receive exclusive updates and stay in the know about what’s hot
in the world of animal fats, including the latest news, recipes, and trends regarding lard and beef
tallow.

[SUBSCRIBE][39]
[Hp hero banner 4]

## Ask Chef Greg

Have a question about using lard or beef tallow? Wondering about the nuances of baking and frying
for your next holiday gathering?  Want to use animal fats creatively while improvising a bit?  Ask
Greg Hozinsky, Coast’s Corporate Chef, who’s been there and done that at some of Southern
California’s finest restaurants.  Drop us a note.

[CONTACT][40]
[Onions]

## Traditional animal fats are on trend for flavor, wellness and sustainability

[IMG_2672_small]
[Viva]
**All-Purpose**[Viva Lard][41]
VIVA, Our Best Lard, is an all-purpose lard carefully processed to impart a traditional, authentic
flavor to popular Hispanic foods. The number one brand of lard in Hispanic cooking for more than 40
years, VIVA has zero trans fats and known for its quality, consistency and performance.
[IMG_2514_small]
[Gold Coast]
**Refined Lard**[Gold Coast][42]
Gold Coast, a truly refined all-purpose lard, is carefully processed to ensure superior results for
baking and frying. Whatever you’re preparing, Gold Coast improves flavor. Use Gold Coast for premium
baked goods, flaky pie crusts and heavy duty frying. With superior creaming properties, a high smoke
point and longer fry life – and zero trans fats – Gold Coast is lard at its best.
[IMG_2611prepared]
[Flavor King]

### How to Pick a Trigger App

Choose any event from **1,000+ apps** — a new email in Gmail, a new row in Airtable, a Stripe
payment, a Slack message, or a custom webhook. Triggers fire instantly or on a schedule. Setup takes
one click — no API keys, no OAuth juggling, no code.

### How to Add Steps & AI Agents

Drag actions into the canvas — send an email, update a row, post a message. Drop in an **AI agent**
(ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any LLM) as a decision node and Flozic calls the model with your
prompt. Add filters, branches, loops, and delays — all visual, no scripting.
* Native ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Mistral & custom-model nodes
* Visual *if/else* branches, loops, and human-in-the-loop steps
* Pass data between steps with a no-code variable picker

### How to Publish & Monitor Your Workflow

input/output, errors, and timing. Pause, edit, version, or roll back any time. The **free plan**
handles 100 runs/month — paid plans scale to enterprise volume.
* Live run history with full step-by-step I/O and error traces
* Pause, version, fork, or roll back any workflow in one click
* Get Slack/email alerts on failures + retry policies per step

## Setting the Gold Standard

## in Global Foodservice

######  

Golden State Foods is one of the largest diversified suppliers to the Quick Service Restaurant and
retail industries. Established in [1947][18] and headquartered in Irvine, California, GSF is
values-based with proven performance in superior quality, innovation, and customer service in both
manufacturing and distribution.


[About Our Company ][19]
[Explore Our History ][20]
SERVICES

### Solutions

GSF’s core businesses include the processing and distribution of liquid products, meat products,
produce, dairy, and other services, providing a variety of networked solutions for the total supply
chain spectrum.

### We're in Your Kitchen

Trusted foodservice equipment guidance, hands‑on testing, and real solutions for operators, dealers
& consultants across the western U.S.

[Let's talk][33]
[Corporate Chefs]

### Professional Advice

EXPERIENCE  [Culinary360]

Our extensive team of Chefs and foodservice professionals are here to work with you and your teams
in all aspects of your business, with an emphasis on front of the house and back of the house
advisory services. Visit our state-of-the-art Test Kitchens for real-time feedback on menu items and
hands on training from our Corporate Chefs!

[Contact][34]
[OneRev Labor Saver Rotating Pizza Oven]

### OneRev Labor Saver Rotating Pizza Oven

The OneRev bakes perfectly cooked artisanal pizzas in ONE ROTATION. A single setting cooks
multiple-size pizzas with an assortment of toppings. Loading and unloading is the only skill
required, minimizing employee training and skill level needed to operate.

[Learn More][35]
[The Culinary 360 Podcast ]

### The Culinary 360 Podcast

The Culinary 360 Podcast is your one-stop podcast, brought to you by Ignite Foodservice Solutions,
where we dish out insights, challenges, and market updates for all things foodservice related. Join
our fiery culinary team as we bring you fresh ideas, resources, and host special guests.

[Listen Now][36]
[Vector® Multi-Cook Ovens ]

### Vector® Multi-Cook Ovens

Vector® H Series ovens are ideal where space is at a premium and you need the flexibility to cook
what you want when you want it.  The countertop models are the perfect solution anywhere you are
tight on space. For more high-volume, back of the house applications we’d recommend the Vector
F-Series. This freestanding oven significantly increases food production with 3 or 4 full-size
chambers.

[Learn More][37]
[ITW Food Equipment Group]

### ITW Food Equipment Group

At ITW Food Equipment Group, people and food are their passion.  Ignite now offers premium brands
from ITW that include: [Baxter][38], [Berkel][39], [Centerline][40], [Gaylord
Ventilation][41], [Hobart][42], [Traulsen][43], [Vulcan][44], & [Wolf.][45]

[View ITW Events][46]

## About Us

Ignite Foodservice Solutions is a manufacturers’ representative firm for the foodservice industry
that represents quality foodservice equipment and supply manufacturers. Sales and sales support
coverage by Ignite includes multiple states in the western part of the United States, with personnel
in five major cities. Ignite uses a combination of sales, culinary support and end user specialists
to meet the demands of our manufacturers, dealers, consultants, and end users.

[Explore Our Manufacturers][47]
[Ignite Foodservice Solutions - Sparky]
[Vector® H Series Multi-Cook Oven]

## Featured Solution by Alto-Shaam

**Vector® H Series Ovens**

Versatility in a ventless footprint.  Vector® H Series ovens are ideal where space is at a premium
and you need the flexibility to cook what you want when you want it. They feature a compact 21″
(533mm) footprint and ventless operation, eliminating the need for an exhaust hood. The countertop
models are the perfect solution anywhere you are tight on space.

Replace or relieve multiple pieces of equipment. These ovens do the job of microwave and speed
ovens, grills, conveyor ovens, salamanders and more – with better food quality all in a small space.

[Explore Alto-Shaam][48]

#### Our Manufacturers

Ignite represents dozens of quality foodservice equipment and supply manufacturers. From tabletop to
back of the house operations, we have the equipment you need.

[Explore Our Lines][49]

#### Our Service Area

We serve eleven states on the west coast of the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii.  We
guarantee regional expertise with team members dedicated to each state we serve.

[Meet Our Team][50]

#### Our Test Kitchens

We offer three test kitchens in the region we serve. Our test kitchens afford you with the ability
to get hands on experience with equipment before making a buying decision.

Trusted foodservice equipment guidance, hands‑on testing, and real solutions for operators, dealers

advisory services. Visit our state-of-the-art Test Kitchens for real-time feedback on menu items and

### OneRev Labor Saver Rotating Pizza Oven

The OneRev bakes perfectly cooked artisanal pizzas in ONE ROTATION. A single setting cooks
multiple-size pizzas with an assortment of toppings. Loading and unloading is the only skill
required, minimizing employee training and skill level needed to operate.

[Learn More][35]
[The Culinary 360 Podcast ]

### The Culinary 360 Podcast

The Culinary 360 Podcast is your one-stop podcast, brought to you by Ignite Foodservice Solutions,
where we dish out insights, challenges, and market updates for all things foodservice related. Join
our fiery culinary team as we bring you fresh ideas, resources, and host special guests.

[Listen Now][36]
[Vector® Multi-Cook Ovens ]

### Vector® Multi-Cook Ovens

Vector® H Series ovens are ideal where space is at a premium and you need the flexibility to cook
what you want when you want it.  The countertop models are the perfect solution anywhere you are
tight on space. For more high-volume, back of the house applications we’d recommend the Vector
F-Series. This freestanding oven significantly increases food production with 3 or 4 full-size
chambers.

[Learn More][37]

### ITW Food Equipment Group

At ITW Food Equipment Group, people and food are their passion.  Ignite now offers premium brands
from ITW that include: [Baxter][38], [Berkel][39], [Centerline][40], [Gaylord
Ventilation][41], [Hobart][42], [Traulsen][43], [Vulcan][44], & [Wolf.][45]

## About Us

Ignite Foodservice Solutions is a manufacturers’ representative firm for the foodservice industry
that represents quality foodservice equipment and supply manufacturers. Sales and sales support
coverage by Ignite includes multiple states in the western part of the United States, with personnel
in five major cities. Ignite uses a combination of sales, culinary support and end user specialists
to meet the demands of our manufacturers, dealers, consultants, and end users.

[Explore Our Manufacturers][47]

Versatility in a ventless footprint.  Vector® H Series ovens are ideal where space is at a premium
and you need the flexibility to cook what you want when you want it. They feature a compact 21″
(533mm) footprint and ventless operation, eliminating the need for an exhaust hood. The countertop
models are the perfect solution anywhere you are tight on space.

Replace or relieve multiple pieces of equipment. These ovens do the job of microwave and speed
ovens, grills, conveyor ovens, salamanders and more – with better food quality all in a small space.

[Explore Alto-Shaam][48]

#### Our Manufacturers

Ignite represents dozens of quality foodservice equipment and supply manufacturers. From tabletop to
back of the house operations, we have the equipment you need.

We serve eleven states on the west coast of the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii.  We
guarantee regional expertise with team members dedicated to each state we serve.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

  * [Our History][4]
    
    ### Our History
    
    From humble beginnings in the 1930s to today’s diversified food company, Peerless Foods has
    evolved through strategic acquisitions and innovations to deliver premium oils, margarines,
    spreads, shortenings and ready-to-use pastries across five market segments nationwide and to
    international markets spanning Asia, the Middle East, and Eastern Europe.
  * [Our Purpose][5]
    
    ### Our Purpose
    
    Peerless isn’t just a name, it’s a promise of excellence. We’ve upheld our high levels of
    quality and service over generations, but we don’t rest on our laurels. We continuously look at
    ways to enhance the lives of Australians and grow global partnerships.
    
    [JUMP TO:][6]

    * [People][8]
  * [Sourcing][9]
    
    ### Sourcing
    
    Peerless Foods are committed to sourcing the best and most ethical sourced ingredients, and will
    always endeavour to source ingredients and packaging from local Australian businesses.

    develop commercially viable, effective products customized to each business customer’s unique
    needs.

### Bringing Quality

From coast-to-coast, Richardson Food & Ingredients strives to produce quality food products you can
trust. We focus on innovative product development that consistently meets the needs of a dynamic and
ever-changing marketplace.

Richardson Food & Ingredients

Richardson creates the ingredients that power many of today’s leading food brands. From canola oils,
margarines, and shortenings to oat- and durum-based ingredients and custom formulations, our
products deliver on quality and performance.

As part of Richardson’s global agriculture and food business, our food and ingredients division
plays a central role in connecting farm to table through our vertically integrated supply chain. We
work closely with our customers to understand their needs and deliver innovative solutions that
support long-term success.

Luminix orchestrates Claude, Grok, and Gemini — using the one that's actually best at each part of
the job.
